channel: Psychonomic Society
description: The Psychonomic Society's One World Cognitive Psychology Seminar Series runs online during the academic year and features a seminar approximately once every month. Each session includes a talk by an exceptional cognitive psychologist, following by audience discussion with participants from all over the world. The series represents an incredible opportunity to reach cognitive psychologists around the world with your latest research, as well as to forge collaborations with fellow scientists doing groundbreaking work.

playlist_title: Symposium on Cognition, Behavior, and Society, previously the D&I Symposium
channel: Psychonomic Society
description:
The Symposium on Cognition, Behavior, and Society, previously the Diversity & Inclusion Symposium, is an invited symposium which focuses on social issues, and their intersection with cognitive processes and human behavior. Discussions will cover topics that reflect Society initiatives and priorities, as identified by the Governing Board, including, but not limited to:

Diversity, equity, and inclusion
Accessibility – breaking down barriers for people with disabilities.
Climate Change and other global problems
Pseudoscience (racial theories, use in politics, etc.)
